Cc: finance@acme.com, peters@thornhill.com

Subject: Q4 finalizer: commit clearance checklist & PO handoff

Morning team —

We’re in the final wave for ACME (ACME-2027-Q4-42). Quick status & asks so we can lock revenue into this quarter: 

1) Commit matrix: I’ve attached the latest commit matrix (redwood_commit_matrix_Q4_v3.xlsx). Please verify: signed SOW amount, remaining milestone to invoice, and any conditional items (e.g., sandbox access obligations).

2) PO / Billing cadence: Acme finance indicated they’ll issue a PO once the SOW is countersigned. David, can you confirm final invoice line items and whether we need to split into two invoices for tax/region reasons?

3) Technical readiness: Monica — confirm that the Dedicated capacity provisioning ETA (region: us-west-2) is still green for Nov 18 and any gating items that could push a milestone.

4) Contingency plan: if PO arrives after EOD Monday, we need to decide whether to carry the commit into next quarter (preferred) or recognize with a revenue hold. Prefer the former but want a clear fallback.

Please update the matrix inline — I’ll roll a close-pack summary at 12:00 PT and escalate if any blocker remains.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0198

Naomi —

Thanks, looking now. Quick notes: 
- I reviewed the matrix. The invoiceable amount and milestone dates match our contract except for one line: professional services (enablement) — Acme requested an extended pilot discount that wasn’t captured in the current SOW PDF. I attached a short redline (acme_signed_sow_v2.pdf) showing the agreed discount.
- Invoice split: we can do two invoices (70% license / 30% services) to satisfy their tax team. That will not change recognition under ASC 606 but will make PO routing easier for Acme.
- If PO arrives after COB Monday (11/08), we should append a one-line revenue deferral note and push recognition pending signed PO. I’ll prepare a short memo for accounting if needed.

Monica — can you confirm whether any pre-provisioning costs apply if we hold capacity for a delayed start? If so, we’ll need to flag for finance.

-David

Quick update from Acme finance and procurement: 
- They have the countersigned SOW and the redline you sent matches their expectations. They will issue a PO but their legal requires the PO number on any invoice. Expect the PO to be generated by close of business Monday (11/08).
- Acme asked for a 7-day start buffer (internal review window). They’re okay with the 70/30 invoice split.
- Please confirm final invoice PDF and billing address. Their AR team specifically needs a remit-to address and vendor tax ID to populate the PO.

If the PO slips beyond Monday, they asked whether we could honor the quoted pricing through the following week; they prefer not to re-run approvals.
